uncertainties.note: 2062 can be a question put to Gainer ('are you okay with this?') or about Gainer ('will he be all right?'); 2063's reply omits its subject (he/you). Both kept open in English. Speakers untagged (2062 likely Sara, 2063 likely Gain, 2058/2061 likely Gain) - not asserted.
Pronoun 'he' used for Berkt (glossary gender male). 'kanbu class no naka demo ... tantou' read as: among the New Federation executives, Berkt is the one assigned to Shin Dragon.

Resource 6061 (rows 2064-2138) is legacy ACE2 material: defense of Konpei Island (ex-Solomon) during the Gundam 0083 naval review, with Giganos (Meio Plato) intervening and Kaine named, ending in Gato's nuclear attack speech; rows 2118-2138 are developer placeholders. Translated faithfully; probably unused in ACE3.

Fortress name: Gundam Wiki lists Confeito / Konpei Island (and 'Konpeitoh' on the episode page). 'Konpei Island' (0083 English release) chosen; needs an orchestrator lock. Used in 2065, 2068, 2074, 2078, 2081.
'Berarabera' matches the Japanese name of Vella Lavella island (Solomon Islands), consistent with the Solomon setting; no Gundam source found that spells this control zone in English.

Source: 'ato wa tenami wo misete morau' - whose skill will be watched is unstated (allied Delaz side or the opposing pilots). English kept open. Speaker by context is Meio withdrawing (2092-2093 react), not asserted.
'S0' could be a callsign being hailed or a sector designation; kept literal with a comma as in source.
'karera' (them) = the side conducting the attack on the naval review; not named in source, not supplied.
Placeholder is a jokey misspelling ('mou damida'); rendered plainly.
